== Biography ==
Mary was born about 1825. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1171|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Gilmore-4240|Eliza Gilmore]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1171]] is assessed at 94% (proved). The 1894 Biographical Review account names Mary E., wife of George W. Bell, among Robert Glasgow and Eliza Gilmore’s two children. The profile’s c 1825 birth conflicts with Robert’s 1809 birth and 1828 arrival, but the named daughter/spouse identification supports this father without accepting that estimate.

Mary E. Glasgow Bell as daughter of Robert-1171; the estimated c 1825 birth is separately unreliable.

Next useful test: Read the 1894 sketch and Mary’s marriage/death record for birth and parents.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3122 Biographical review, sketches of the leading citizens of Cayuga County, N. Y (vol. 1)]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
